title: One Click to Sound: The Silent Loop Becomes a Poster | vitalii.no
description:
The silent demo clip on vitalii.no is muted on purpose — it autoplays in the features hub grid, and browsers block sound there anyway. But on an individual feature page, that silent loop was the entire video experience: the narrated cut sat behind a plain text link below it that almost nobody followed, so most visitors on a feature page never actually heard the explanation of what the feature does.

FeatureDemoClip.tsx gained two new props, youtubeId and soundLabel. When a youtubeId is set, an overlay button now appears on the muted, looping video; clicking it swaps the element for the same feature's narrated cut, playing with sound. Without a youtubeId the component behaves exactly as before, so every feature that doesn't have a narrated cut yet renders with no regression at all.

A feature page visitor now reaches the narrated, sound-on cut in exactly one click on the clip itself, instead of needing to notice and follow a separate link underneath it.
